f.title: Comply with part 822 when FDA orders section 522 postmarket surveillance
f.statement: Part 822 applies to a manufacturer that FDA has ordered to conduct postmarket surveillance of a medical device under section 522 of the FD&C Act. FDA may order surveillance of any class II or class III device (including devices licensed under section 351 of the PHS Act) whose failure would be reasonably likely to have serious adverse health consequences, that is intended to be implanted for more than 1 year, that is intended to support or sustain life and be used outside a user facility, or that is expected to have significant use in pediatric populations.
f.clause: § 822.4 Does this part apply to me?
f.applicability: Class II or class III devices subject to a section 522 postmarket surveillance order

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
If we have ordered you to conduct
postmarket surveillance of a medical
device under section 522 of the Federal
Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, this
part applies to you. We have the authority to order postmarket surveillance of any class II or class III medical device, including a device reviewed
under the licensing provisions of section 351 of the Public Health Service
Act, that meets any of the following
criteria:
(a) Failure of the device would be
reasonably likely to have serious adverse health consequences;
(b) The device is intended to be implanted in the human body for more
than 1 year;
(c) The device is intended to be used
to support or sustain life and to be
used outside a user facility; or
(d) The device is expected to have
significant use in pediatric populations.

f.title: Request to terminate or modify surveillance when the device is no longer marketed, and continue until FDA agrees
f.statement: The manufacturer may request that FDA allow it to terminate or modify postmarket surveillance because it no longer markets the device; FDA decides case by case, and the manufacturer must continue the surveillance unless FDA notifies it that it may stop.
f.clause: § 822.28 If I stop marketing the device subject to postmarket surveillance, what must I do?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
You may request that we allow you to terminate
postmarket surveillance or modify
your postmarket surveillance because
you no longer market the device. We
will make these decisions on a case-bycase basis, and you must continue to
conduct the postmarket surveillance
unless we notify you that you may stop
your surveillance study.
rows.location: § 822.28 If I stop marketing the device subject to postmarket surveillance, what must I do?

f.title: Request a waiver of a specific part 822 requirement
f.statement: The manufacturer may request that FDA waive any specific requirement of part 822, submitting the request with supporting documentation separately or as part of its postmarket surveillance submission to the address in 822.8.
f.clause: § 822.29 May I request a waiver of a specific requirement of this part?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:

specific requirement of this part. You

as a part of your postmarket surveillance submission to the address in
§ 822.8.
rows.location: § 822.29 May I request a waiver of a specific requirement of this part?

f.title: Request exemption from conducting postmarket surveillance
f.statement: The manufacturer may request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance for its device or any specific model at any time.
f.clause: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:

surveillance for your device or any specific model of that device at any time.
rows.location: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

f.title: Keep complying with part 822 until FDA grants an exemption
f.statement: The manufacturer must comply with the requirements of part 822 unless and until FDA grants an exemption for its device.
f.clause: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
You must comply with the requirements of this part unless and until we

rows.location: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

f.title: Explain why the device or model should be exempt from surveillance
f.statement: The exemption request must explain why the manufacturer believes FDA should exempt the device or model from postmarket surveillance.
f.clause: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
Your request for exemption must explain why you believe we should exempt the device or model from
postmarket surveillance.
rows.location: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

f.title: Show why the surveillance question does not apply or need not be answered
f.statement: The manufacturer should demonstrate why the surveillance question does not apply to its device or does not need to be answered for the device for which it requests exemption.
f.clause: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
You should
demonstrate why the surveillance

f.title: Alternatively provide information that answers the surveillance question
f.statement: Alternatively, the manufacturer may provide information, with supporting documentation, that answers the surveillance question for its device, to the address in 822.8.
f.clause: § 822.30 May I request exemption from the requirement to conduct postmarket surveillance?

f.title: Keep all correspondence with investigators and FDA, including required reports
f.statement: The manufacturer must keep copies of all correspondence with its investigators or FDA, including required reports.
f.clause: § 822.31(a) What records am I required to keep?

f.title: Keep signed investigator agreements
f.statement: If the surveillance plan uses investigators, the manufacturer must keep copies of signed agreements from each investigator stating the commitment to conduct the surveillance in accordance with the approved plan, applicable FDA regulations and any conditions of approval such as reporting requirements.
f.clause: § 822.31(b) What records am I required to keep?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:

rows.location: § 822.31(b) What records am I required to keep?

f.title: Keep the approved plan with documented deviations
f.statement: The manufacturer must keep a copy of its approved postmarket surveillance plan, with documentation of the date and reason for any deviation from the plan.
f.clause: § 822.31(c) What records am I required to keep?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.location: § 822.31(c) What records am I required to keep?

f.title: Keep all data collected and analyses conducted
f.statement: The manufacturer must keep copies of all data collected and analyses conducted in support of its postmarket surveillance plan.

of
your

f.title: Keep other records required by regulation or order, such as consent and IRB documents
f.statement: The manufacturer must keep copies of any other records FDA requires by regulation or by order, such as signed consent documents and evidence of IRB review and approval.
f.clause: § 822.31(e) What records am I required to keep?

rows.actor: Manufacturer ordered to conduct section 522 postmarket surveillance
rows.quote:
(e) Any other records that we require
to be maintained by regulation or by
order, such as copies of signed consent
documents, evidence of Institutional
Review Board review and approval, etc.
rows.location: § 822.31(e) What records am I required to keep?

f.title: Investigator: keep correspondence, the approved plan with deviations, site data and other required records
f.statement: Each investigator in the surveillance plan must keep copies of all correspondence between investigators, FDA, the manufacturer and the designated person (including required reports); the approved plan with documentation of the date and reason for any deviation; all data collected and analyses conducted at the site; and any other records FDA requires by regulation or order.
f.clause: § 822.32 What records are the investigators in my surveillance plan required to keep?

rows.actor: Investigator in the surveillance plan
rows.quote:
Your investigator must keep copies
of:
(a) All correspondence between investigators, FDA, the manufacturer, and
the designated person, including required reports.
(b) The approved postmarket surveillance plan, with documentation of the
date and reason for any deviation from
the plan.
(c) All data collected and analyses
conducted at that site for postmarket
surveillance.
(d) Any other records that we require
to be maintained by regulation or by
order.
rows.location: § 822.32 What records are the investigators in my surveillance plan required to keep?

f.title: Keep all surveillance records for 2 years after FDA accepts the final report
f.statement: The manufacturer, the designated person and the investigators must keep all records for 2 years after FDA has accepted the final report, unless FDA specifies otherwise.
f.clause: § 822.33 How long must we keep the records?

rows.location: § 822.33 How long must we keep the records?

f.title: Transfer records and notify FDA within 10 working days when the sponsor or an investigator changes
f.statement: If the sponsor of the plan or an investigator changes, the manufacturer must ensure that all records related to the postmarket surveillance have been transferred to the new sponsor or investigator and notify FDA within 10 working days of the effective date of the change.
f.clause: § 822.34 What must I do with the records if the sponsor of the plan or an investigator in the plan changes?

f.title: Permit FDA to enter and inspect facilities holding the device or surveillance records
f.statement: Any person authorized to grant access to a facility must permit authorized FDA employees to enter and inspect any facility where the device is held or where records regarding postmarket surveillance are held.
f.clause: § 822.35 Can you inspect my manufacturing site or other sites involved in my postmarket surveillance plan?

f.title: Be able to produce surveillance records held by contractors
f.statement: The manufacturer must be able to produce records and information required by part 822 that are in the possession of others under contract with it to conduct the postmarket surveillance.

f.title: Submit additional information FDA requests for public health protection
f.statement: FDA may ask the manufacturer to submit additional information when it believes the information is necessary for the protection of the public health and implementation of the act; FDA will state the reason or purpose and how it will use the information.
